description: Festgesetzte Überschwemmungsgebiete des Landes Brandenburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.geobasis-bb.de. The spatial data set contains all flood zones of the State of Brandenburg already determined in accordance with Section 100(2), second sentence, of the BbgWG, including the associated foothills. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fixed floodplains of the state of Brandenburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ENVI, opendata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-08-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
